name: TextInput
description: The TextInput component provides an accessible, fully-featured text input field with support for labels, helper text, validation, and error states. It is designed to be used as a controlled component.
usage: Use as a controlled component with value and onChange props
Leverage the validate prop for custom inline validation logic
Error messages are displayed only when the field is touched (after blur)
External errors (from error prop) override internal validation errors
Helper text provides additional context and is hidden when errors are shown
Always provide a unique id for accessibility
Mark required fields with the required prop for both visual and semantic indication
Use the onBlur callback to mark fields as touched
design: Labels use `.type-label` (14px medium) for consistent form styling.
Helper text uses `.type-caption` which includes muted color semantically.
Error messages use `.type-body-sm` (14px) with error color override.
Compact mode uses h-7 (28px) height, smaller typography: `.type-label-sm` (12px) for labels, `.type-caption` for errors, `.type-caption-compact` (10px) for helper text. Aligns with Button size='xs'.
Number inputs have custom styled increment/decrement buttons with ChevronUp/ChevronDown icons, replacing native browser spinners for consistent cross-browser appearance.
accessibility: Labels are properly associated with inputs using the for/id relationship
Error states are communicated to assistive technology via aria-invalid and aria-describedby
Helper text is linked to the input using aria-describedby
Required fields are marked both visually and with the required attribute
Number input spinner buttons have aria-labels and are removed from tab order (tabIndex=-1) to preserve native keyboard navigation

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the input (required for accessibility)

props.name: label
props.description: Text label displayed above the input

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hides the label visually; screen readers still read it as the field's name. For a field whose purpose the layout already shows.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value of the input (controlled component)

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback function executed when the input value changes

props.name: error
props.description: External error message (e.g., from server validation). Overrides internal validation error

props.name: validate
props.description: Validation function. Returns an error message string if invalid, null or undefined if valid

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the input (not shown when an error is displayed)

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS class for the container element

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Additional CSS class specifically for the input element

props.name: touched
props.description: Whether the field has been interacted with (e.g., blurred). Controls when validation errors are displayed

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback function executed when the input loses focus. Typically used to set touched state to true

props.name: required
props.description: Indicates if the field is required (adds visual marker and native attribute)

props.name: compact
props.description: Enables compact mode with h-7 (28px) height, smaller typography (type-body-sm), and reduced padding for space-constrained UIs. Aligns with Button size='xs'.
